The '''''Wrath''''' was an [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], built sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
The ''Wrath'' was among the first [[Starship|ships]] of its class to have been developed, prior to the Battle of Yavin, being the only ship in existence other than the lead ship, the ''[[Assertor/Legends|Assertor]]''. Like other ships in its class, it acted as a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] command and control ship, and was often flanked by ''[[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|Bellator]]'' and [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-class]] [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|dreadnoughts]] when undergoing [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] maneuvers.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

At one point it led a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] operation.<ref name="EGW" /> It was important enough within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to necessitate the usage of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] to accompany it on the mission.<ref name="TIE/D presence explanation post">{{WebCite|url=http://www.scifi-meshes.com/forums/showthread.php?2212-Star-Wars-projects-thread&p=548825&viewfull=1#post548825|text=Star Wars projects thread|author=fractalsponge|date=2012-04-09|archivedate=20160317151018}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Similar to the class of Star Dreadnought it belonged to, the ''Wrath'' originated as a [[fanon]] design by [[Ansel Hsiao]], envisioned as a 15 kilometer long warship with power generation approximately equivalent to 400 [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="AHPSD1">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?p=3242676#p3242676|text=Something big|author=fractalsponge1|date=2010-10-02|work=[https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/index.php StarDestroyer.Net BBS]|archivedate=20200615214309}}</ref> The design [[List of fanon elements in continuity|entered continuity]] when it appeared in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', on which Ansel worked as an illustrator. [[Jason Fry]], author of ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', confirmed in his blog that the class name and specifications have been officially recorded by [[Lucas Licensing]].<ref name="endnotes" /> When questioned about the large amount of TIE/D Defender starfighters during the ''Wrath''{{'s}} Base Delta Zero operation and at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']], Hsiao implied that their presence was because of the strategic importance of the ship/its mission and the location, respectively.<ref name="TIE/D presence explanation post" />

According to Hsiao, the ''Wrath'' in the BDZ artwork was originally supposed to be focused on the stern as it was beginning the BDZ, with the main engines firing up in order to compensate recoil. However, an editorial decision resulted in him having to flip the vessel around to make it "more clear," and was not able to adjust the turbolaser volleys (which were originally going to be on the central batteries on the hidden side of the ship) to match the new ship. Because of this, Hsiao had to rationalize that it was merely the beginning of the fleet bombardment, but turning to face an enemy force coming in offscreen from behind camera.<ref name="orbital bombardment">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1600#p3663162|text=Somethig big|author=fractalsponge1|date=2012-04-09|work=[https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/index.php StarDestroyer.Net BBS]|archivedate=20160411074759}}</ref>
